heuristic_note: The lone binary/unknown heuristic result is itself mostly readable translated text plus control bytes. Payload inspection found no record without ASCII letters.
observations: All 83 patch records contain at least one ASCII letter.
Most records are directly readable Spanish player-facing strings; the remainder mix readable text with control/non-printable bytes.
No pure binary-only patch record was identified in this 85% release.
This evidence strongly supports three text/control-data clusters in LoROM banks $80, $83, and $97; it does not by itself prove the reader routines or the meaning of each control byte.
No separate font-graphics, pointer-table, checksum/header, or executable-code-only edit is evidenced by the patch payloads.
